title: Brivel
description: Free, open source endurance and strength training plans that adapt to your own data. A Kotlin Multiplatform core runs the training engine on the device and powers native Android (Compose) and iOS (SwiftUI) apps plus a React web app. It reads Apple Health, Health Connect, intervals.icu and Garmin Connect, and syncs between devices with end-to-end encryption through Cloudflare Workers.
